name: Obadiah
overview: Obadiah is a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, uniquely identified as the son of Azel. Beyond this paternal connection, Scripture does not provide additional details or notes about his life or role.
namesAndTitles: The name Obadiah means 'servant [worshiper] of YHWH,' reflecting a devotional relationship to God. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:38, underscores his identity within the covenant community as one devoted to the Lord.
familyAndRelationships: Obadiah is explicitly recorded as the son of Azel. There are no further family relationships noted in Scripture beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Obadiah's significance in the biblical narrative is primarily genealogical, serving to trace the lineage within the tribe of Benjamin. His mention as the son of Azel situates him within the broader context of Israel's tribal history, emphasizing the faithfulness of God's people through successive generations.
